# Mobile design in Figma — selected reasoning from the supplied report

The Russian report supplied on 2026-11-12 is preserved in a private indexed
snapshot with SHA-256
2dc6f620bd9783fff65c05fd32066916073270c3e62a86c0c151e9772f58908b.
The references below use that snapshot's section IDs. Its proposed portal and
unavailable Memphis example are design illustrations. The report has incomplete
claim-level citations and gives conflicting Android top bar values. Those
values and other device geometry stay in the private source as reported.

sections.title: Own spacing at the level of the relationship
sections.text:
## Own spacing at the level of the relationship

A component can own the spacing among its meaningful parts and between its
content and boundary. The composition owns spacing between component
instances. For example, a button can keep the gap between its label and icon
while a form and a toolbar use different gaps between buttons. Change the
shared definition if the button's internal relationship is wrong. Change the
container if the spacing issue is between siblings in one composition. A
shared row or group can own the sibling spacing when that grouping itself has
a reusable contract. This is a design ownership decision. The tool supports
padding and gap at each nested frame and can allow instance changes.

Report R004, R005 and R010.
[Figma Help Center — Guide to auto layout](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040451373-Guide-to-auto-layout-in-Figma)
confirms the tool concepts and nesting. It does not mandate this ownership
arrangement or any spacing scale.

sections.title: Choose search scope independently of its entry
sections.text:
## Choose search scope independently of its entry

The report's proposed portal contrasts search within news and search across
the entire portal. The same field anatomy can serve both. The query domain,
label or scope controls and results context should make the difference clear.
A local filter can remain with the collection even if the app also provides
a global search entry. A toolbar, inline field and dedicated surface are
presentation choices. Choose an entry appropriate to the task and target.
Verify the actual dataset and where the person returns after a result or
dismissal. The latter check follows Fab's existing continuation knowledge.

Report R012 and R015. [Apple HIG — Search fields](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/search-fields/)
supports identifying the scope and choosing access patterns according to goals
and platform. It does not validate the report's specific platform timings,
search behavior or portal implementation.
